description: Authored spatial rhythms for the connected-world expansion. Anchors are [x, y, width] platform silhouettes; the expansion tool turns each district profile into role-specific, reviewable room geometry.

rooftop_alley.spatial_rhythm: close rooftop steps opening into a broadcast overlook

billboard_highway.spatial_rhythm: long lateral lanes broken by shallow advertising-rail rises

communication_spire.spatial_rhythm: tight central ascent with alternating relay shelves

skybridge_junction.spatial_rhythm: broad wind gaps linked by staggered suspended decks

executive_helipad.spatial_rhythm: perimeter approach circling a low exposed landing pad

sub_level_intake.spatial_rhythm: descending service shelves pressed between intake channels

conveyor_assembly.spatial_rhythm: low horizontal sorting lanes with abrupt counterflow changes

smelting_core.spatial_rhythm: compact cool islands climbing around an open furnace throat

robotic_maintenance.spatial_rhythm: alternating service pockets beneath descending repair machinery

assembly_engine.spatial_rhythm: steady piston-step ascent toward the engine ignition lock

lunar_surface_arrival.spatial_rhythm: wide low-gravity arcs across shallow crater shelves

research_cleanrooms.spatial_rhythm: sterile switchbacks threading transparent containment cells

security_grid_shaft.spatial_rhythm: narrow vertical climb through offset security apertures

bio_tech_labs.spatial_rhythm: orbiting ledges around suspended culture vessels

orbital_command.spatial_rhythm: symmetrical command-ring lanes converging on a central hub

corrupted_outpost.spatial_rhythm: broken shelter-to-shelter steps across exposed corruption

the_dark_chasm.spatial_rhythm: blind descending ledges that resolve into a deep return shelf
the_dark_chasm.landmark: fossil lift suspended over the chasm

bio_mechanical_nest.spatial_rhythm: contracting sinew bridges wrapped around a pulsing central chamber

abyssal_sanctuary.spatial_rhythm: ceremonial mirrored steps interrupted by gravity reversals

heart_of_the_void.spatial_rhythm: pulsing concentric rises closing around the final core
